title: ID0465088-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/R6 170001968] - long charging session
description:
Reported behavior/issue- long charging session
Solution: Seems that the EV didn't change pilotState and only after the reboot we can see the available state, possible that it was plugged out during reboot.

additional_info.subject: ID0465088-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/R6 170001968] - long charging session CRM:03056000649
additional_info.body:
Hello Lara, good morning.
Thank you for your patience so far.
I checked the logs and found that the charging was aborted, and the PilotState changed from C2 to C1, which indicates that the charger was still in communication with the EV, only when the EV changes the PilotState from C to B, we have a session stop.
After a reboot, the outlet becomes available again, so we cannot confirm if the problem was related to hardware or software, unless there is someone that can prove that the plug was removed before or during the restart.
If they plug out during the restart, then we can only assume that the EV was the one that didn't unlock since they are the responsible.
If they plug out before the restart then we need to align with the field service team for a site visit.
Let me know your feedback.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
